ships.name: Pursuer
ships.brief: A long, low corvette built around an aft twin-fighter hangar. Swept gun shoulders protect a compact command deck.
notes: Two Jackals side by side aft.
Laser rooms sit directly behind the broadside mounts.
Bridge and bunks occupy a narrower upper pressure hull.
adjustments: Forward stores and the torpedo room follow the tapered shoulders.
The bridge corners and aft cabins now follow the upper hull.
The hangar keeps both 8 m fighter berths and its central lane.

ships.name: Splitjaw
ships.brief: Two forward launch jaws frame a protected service pocket. The bridge stays behind the launch line, with machinery grouped aft.
notes: One fighter bay in each forward jaw.
A cross-passage connects both bays without entering either.
Aft reactor and drive form one short service route.
adjustments: The aft reactor and drive rooms narrow into the engine roots.
Both fighter bays acquire faceted outer corners and keep their service clearance.
The bridge recesses behind the launch jaws; the cross-passage stays connected.

ships.name: Bulwark
ships.brief: A broad armored bow shields the weapons deck. A compact command block sits over a deep central hull and a paired aft launch bay.
notes: A broad forward battery replaces the needle-shaped bow.
Magazines stay beside the guns and away from the hangar.
Three decks concentrate the occupied volume behind armor.
adjustments: The wide laser battery follows the faceted bow shield.
Aft bunks and mess narrow where the battery meets the engine shoulders.
Upper command rooms shrink to the protected block while all three decks keep their ladder connection.
